verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own AI agent, Seer, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Sentry acting as an MCP server that AI assistants connect to, which is the opposite role and earns no credit here. Nothing shows Seer or any other Sentry feature consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
